column_description: Unique identifier for each loan record (primary key).
Identifier of the borrower’s account; foreign key to the account table.
Date the loan was originated or issued.
Principal amount of the loan (currency units).
Length of the loan term, likely expressed in months.
Regular payment amount (e.g., monthly) for the loan.
Loan status code; observed values: A (active/current), B (paid off/closed), C (defaulted/charged‑off), D (delinquent/overdue).
